description: A company whose sales directly grow with the theme should classify as beneficiary, not enabler.
theme_description: Automakers and battery makers are commercializing solid-state cell chemistry for electric vehicles.
evidence_quotes: Acme Battery Co says orders for its new solid-state cells have tripled as automakers switch from lithium-ion.
Acme Battery Co expects solid-state cell revenue to become its largest product line within two years.
notes: Direct revenue upside from the theme's growth, not a supplier of inputs to it.

description: A supplier of a critical input the theme's core companies depend on should classify as enabler.
theme_description: Automakers and battery makers are commercializing solid-state cell chemistry for electric vehicles.
evidence_quotes: Solid Separator Materials Inc is the sole qualified supplier of the ceramic electrolyte separator every major solid-state cell maker uses.
Battery makers say they cannot scale solid-state production without Solid Separator Materials Inc's separator film.
notes: Supplies a critical input the theme's core activity depends on, distinct from directly selling the end product.

description: A company deploying the theme's technology in its own operations, without being a primary beneficiary of the theme's overall growth, should classify as adopter.
theme_description: Automakers and battery makers are commercializing solid-state cell chemistry for electric vehicles.
evidence_quotes: Continental Freight Lines says it is converting a quarter of its delivery fleet to EVs using solid-state battery packs to cut charging downtime.
Continental Freight Lines is not a battery maker or automaker -- it operates a trucking and logistics business.
notes: Uses the technology operationally; the theme's growth doesn't directly grow this company's own core revenue line.

description: A company visibly shifting its business away from a legacy position toward the theme should classify as transition_candidate.
theme_description: Automakers and battery makers are commercializing solid-state cell chemistry for electric vehicles.
evidence_quotes: Legacy Lithium Corp, historically a lithium-ion cell maker, announced it will convert two of its four production lines to solid-state cells by next year.
Legacy Lithium Corp's CEO said the shift is necessary because lithium-ion demand is plateauing as solid-state cells mature.
notes: Explicit shift away from a legacy position toward the theme, not simply an existing player expanding capacity.

description: A company controlling a scarce resource or chokepoint the theme depends on should classify as bottleneck_owner.
theme_description: Automakers and battery makers are commercializing solid-state cell chemistry for electric vehicles.
evidence_quotes: Rare Earth Holdings Ltd controls the only two mines currently producing the lithium-lanthanum-zirconate compound solid-state cells require.
Solid-state cell makers have warned that Rare Earth Holdings Ltd's mine capacity is the binding constraint on how fast they can scale production.
notes: Controls a scarce input the whole theme's growth is gated on, not just one of many suppliers.

description: A legacy incumbent the theme displaces should classify as negatively_exposed.
theme_description: Automakers and battery makers are commercializing solid-state cell chemistry for electric vehicles.
evidence_quotes: OldChem Electrolyte Fluids makes the liquid electrolyte used in conventional lithium-ion cells, which solid-state cells eliminate entirely.
Analysts say OldChem Electrolyte Fluids' core product line has no role in solid-state cell manufacturing and faces declining demand as adoption grows.
notes: The theme's growth directly displaces this company's core product, the opposite of a beneficiary.

description: Thin, non-committal evidence should classify as ambiguous rather than forcing a confident guess -- guards against overreach on weak evidence.
theme_description: Automakers and battery makers are commercializing solid-state cell chemistry for electric vehicles.
evidence_quotes: Generic Industrial Holdings was mentioned in passing in an industry roundup article about the EV battery sector.
notes: No concrete claim about what this company actually does relative to the theme -- a mere mention, not evidence of a role.
